headlines.title: Starbucks Just Hiked Its Dividend by 1.6%. Here’s Why It’s Still Not an Obvious ‘Buy.’
headlines.summary: Starbucks raised its quarterly dividend by about 1.6% to $0.63 per share ahead of its Oct. 29 fiscal fourth-quarter report, after global comparable sales rose 7.9% in the prior quarter.

headlines.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Reportedly Explored A Takeover That Could Reshape Restaurants
headlines.summary: Starbucks (NasdaqGS:SBUX) has reportedly explored a takeover of Chipotle Mexican Grill in a potential mega restaurant tie up. The discussions, which would have combined a major coffee chain and a fast casual burrito specialist, did not advance to a formal offer. Any transaction would likely have ranked among the largest deals in the restaurant sector by equity value if it had proceeded.

headlines.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock with Competitive Advantages and 2 We Brush Off
headlines.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
